verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded lists health insurance as a partner offering via SimplyInsured, so it is a third-party integration rather than a documented native enrollment flow. The payroll docs confirm benefits deductions and contributions carry into regular and off-cycle payrolls. Community users say Gusto handles payroll and benefits, but report limited plan customization across multiple states and a plan termination that was mishandled. Missing for 10: documented enrollment/eligibility workflows, explicit API docs for syncing health-insurance enrollments to payroll deductions, native (non-partner) plan administration, and independent corroboration of reliable termination handling.
